title: Warm Crunchy Ethiopian Chickpeas Skillet
description: A flavorful and nutritious Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring crunchy chickpeas, hojicha tea, and anti-inflammatory spices, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe combines the warmth of Ethiopian spices with the comfort of a crunchy skillet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the berbere spice, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Pour in the hojicha tea and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the chickpeas are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve the Warm Crunchy Ethiopian Chickpeas Skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
